_note: Hand-curated preset selections for the map explorer (map.html). Each group is a name, a one-line blurb, a suggested base-map extent, and an ordered list of place_id values that must exist in data/places-index.json with coordinates. Not generated — edit by hand; verify every id against the index before adding. Groups are listed in rough biblical-chronological order; keep new groups in that order. Optional per-group `journeys`: an array of {label, waypoints:[place_id,...]} route overlays drawn as dashed, arrow-headed lines in the map explorer (toggled by 'Show journey arrows', on by default when a group has them). Every waypoint id should also appear in that group's `places`. Keep routes to what the biblical narrative plainly states — see CLAUDE.md 'Places / Map'.
